settings.heading: The practical details, before we begin.
settings.text: Custom packaging has many moving parts. Here are clear answers about quantities, timing, artwork, samples, materials, production, and delivery.

settings.question: What is the minimum order quantity?
settings.answer: Minimum order quantities depend on the box structure, materials, finishing, and production method. Share your target quantity and launch requirements, and we will recommend the most practical route.

settings.question: How long does a custom packaging project take?
settings.answer: Timing depends on structural complexity, sampling rounds, order quantity, finishing, and delivery destination. A typical project moves through briefing, engineering, sampling, approval, production, and freight. We provide a working schedule before the project begins.

settings.question: Can you work from an existing dieline or design?
settings.answer: Yes. We can manufacture from approved artwork and dielines, refine an existing structure, or develop the packaging system with your team from the beginning.

settings.question: Can I receive a physical prototype before production?
settings.answer: Yes. Physical samples allow you to test fit, opening experience, materials, color, and finishing before approving mass production.

settings.question: What sustainable material options are available?
settings.answer: We source FSC-certified paperboards, specialty papers, and lower-impact material options according to the structure, finish, and durability required by the project.

settings.question: Do you handle freight and delivery to North America?
settings.answer: Yes. We align production, quality control, freight, and delivery requirements, with communication managed through the Root & Route team in Canada.

settings.heading: Tell us what you're packing.
settings.body: Send the product dimensions and your run size. We come back with a structure recommendation, a dieline and a quote.
